# CG-REQ-014: Request media type removed

The request body no longer accepts a media type.

**Why it matters:** Consumers cannot send a payload in a media type the provider no longer accepts.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `mediaType.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Request media type {mediaType} is no longer accepted by {operation}.
>
> Consumers sending {mediaType} will be rejected (typically 415).
>
> **Fix:** Keep accepting {mediaType}, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: application/xml removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/xml: {}, application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Request media type application/xml is no longer accepted by POST /x.

### Does not fire: charset spelling normalized

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {'text/plain; charset=UTF-8': {}, application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {'text/plain; charset=utf-8': {}, application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Content negotiation beyond the specification is unknown.

      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
